description: When an Earth satellite (ISS = 25544, Tiangong = 48274, Hubble = 20580, or any NORAD number) passes over a place: rise, highest point and set times with direction (azimuth, compass point) and elevation, and whether it can be seen with the naked eye (sunlit satellite, dark sky) and when. Give the place's latitude and longitude (degrees, east positive) and, for local times, its IANA time zone. Up to 3 days ahead.

height_m.description: Observer height above sea level, m.

id.description: Object id from perigee_find (NORAD number, mission id, planet, "moon:<id>", "site:<id>", "launch:<id>", "star:<id>", "comet:<id>", "asteroid:<id>" or a dwarf planet name), e.g. "25544" for the ISS.

lang.description: Language of names and texts (default en).

min_elevation.description: Lowest culmination kept and lowest elevation counted as visible, degrees (default 10).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for local times, e.g. "America/Toronto".

name: perigee_passes
title: Satellite passes over a place
